changed_surfaces.purpose: Expose tenant-scoped published and deployed workflow candidates, start by definition ID, and provide active-reference lifecycle protection.
Persist five project-scoped scene bindings with optimistic locking, audit history, permissions, and workflow reference reporting.
Resolve the server-derived scene binding and freeze the actual definition ID, version, and instance on each approval round.
Provide project-aware approval workflow configuration, history, unbind, reasoned updates, and explicit partial state.
Apply V43 and create disposable deployed workflows, bindings, windows, and applications for integrated verification without modifying ccb_platform.

diff_summary: Configuration management now owns five fixed project approval scenes and binds each scene to a published, deployed workflow definition.
Release submission resolves bindings server-side and rejects only the submitted unconfigured or invalid scene atomically.
Approval rounds retain immutable workflow definition, version, and instance identity across later rebinding.
Binding updates require reasons, support optimistic locking, preserve history, and protect referenced definitions from destructive lifecycle actions.
The frontend exposes configuration and history without allowing workflow graph editing or manual workflow-code input.

disturbances.event: Legacy seeded definitions were marked PUBLISHED but had no Flowable deployment.
disturbances.impact: Initial submission failed with Flowable workflow definition missing; candidate and requirePublished queries were bounded to require definition and version deployment IDs, then focused tests and runtime submission passed.

disturbances.event: Database CURRENT_TIMESTAMP follows the UTC container session while the application exposes timezone-less LocalDateTime values.
disturbances.impact: Binding-history timestamps display about eight hours behind Shanghai time; the same platform convention affects multiple modules and requires a central time contract rather than a release-only offset.

assumptions_falsified: PUBLISHED status alone does not guarantee that a legacy workflow can be started; a valid Flowable deployment is also required.
unresolved_items: Platform-wide database session and JSON timestamp semantics should be normalized centrally; the current module does not apply a local +8-hour workaround.
